title: From the Air: Kitchener Condo and Rental Construction Advances
summary:
A recent set of drone photographs by UrbanToronto Forum contributor ZEBuilder offers an aerial tour of construction across Kitchener and Waterloo, updating many construction projects across the conjoined cities west of Toronto. This first instalment catches up with progress at three sites in Kitchener.

 

At 864 King Street West, the future 44-storey rental apartment tower now reaches 11 storeys, with work progressing on the 12th and 13th floors where the formwork can be seen. The six-storey podium’s L-shaped footprint features step-backs defining the transition to the narrower tower floor-plate.
